name: smwgraphics-metroid-brinstar
title: Metroid - Brinstar
description:
A complete rip of the first area from the original Metroid. Everything from the original game should be accounted for.

Some notes:
-The cracked blocks and Item Spheres require a custom block that can be broken with projectiles. Such a block can easily be made using Blockreactor
-There are two different backs for the Chozo Statues, one of which is solid while the other is not. Only use the solid backside when the Chozo Statue is facing against a wall.
-The Zeb pipes and the tops of Chozo Statues are passthrough unlike the original game due to the lack of any kind of slab blocks, both in the vanilla SMW and in the Blocks section.
-The only used vanilla colors that are overwritten are the berry colors. No other non-blank colors are affected.

Credit to Mica for ripping the original tiles on TSR that I used as reference.
